author: reek
body: Wires the hand-authored card library into real games. The pool is the authored Old School cards plus the five basics; decks are built per colour by the existing RealDeck curve builder; games run through the ordinary pre-game and Simulate AI. So an actual AI-vs-AI match plays out on real cards whose behaviour came from the authored IR -- not the runtime text parser. Adding cards to CardLibrary makes them immediately playable here.
